answer: Persistent Terrace Ledger: each identity must hold a public, continuously updated log of past interactions that only accrues through real-time participation, never transferred or copied. New identities start blank and must wait out a cooling period before others route work to them, giving honest agents a ferrous record advantage clones cannot fake. An attacker running many identities pays sustained attention across all of them just to reach baseline trust, splitting effort and capping each clone's usable history; a quiet haven of dormant accounts gains nothing.
